title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
**Position\- Technical L2 Support Specialist**

**Experience: 2\-3 years**

**Joining: Immediately /within 30 days**

**Work Location: Gurugram, Haryana (Hybrid)/ WFH**

**Job Type: Full\-Time**

**Shift Time: Flexible with US time overlap**

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a dedicated and motivated Technical L2 Support Specialist to join our team. The ideal candidate will provide exceptional email and phone support to our US\-based customers, ensuring their issues are resolved efficiently and effectively. This role requires excellent communication skills, strong email writing capabilities, and a good command of the English language.

**Responsibilities:**

\- Provide Level 2 support for customers via email and phone, resolving issues related to our products/services.

\- Work in overlapping shifts with US time to ensure prompt customer response and support.

\- Handle and resolve customer complaints and inquiries in a professional and timely manner.

\- Escalate complex issues to higher support levels when necessary, while maintaining ownership until resolution.

\- Maintain accurate and detailed records of customer interactions and issue resolutions.

\- Assist in creating and updating support documentation to help improve the customer experience.

\- Collaborate with internal teams to relay customer feedback and help drive product/service improvements.

**Requirements:**

\- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English is must.

\- Strong email writing skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.

\- Customer\-focused attitude with the ability to handle inquiries and technical issues calmly and efficiently.

\- Willingness to work in overlapping shifts with US time zones.

\- Basic understanding of customer service principles and practices.

\- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

\- Previous experience in technical support or a related field is mandatory.

\- Previous experience in IT industry would be preferred.

**Company Details:** 

CerebrumX is the Connected Car Data Ecosystem company with the objective to democratize the Connected Car Data Ecosystem. It’s proprietary Advanced Deep Learning Platform (ADLP), provides easy to Use Development Interface though open APIs to allow Consumers build their customized business use cases. ADLP is a Trusted and Neutral source of Connected Car Data Augmented with Social, Location, Weather and Mobility data to drive better business decisions in changing ecosystem. ADLP allows to create Enriched Data Market Place of use cases catering to different verticals including Car OEMs, FINTECH, Insurance, City Planners, Media Companies, Car Dealerships, etc. ADLP provides a plug\-in to manage and maintain Data Privacy, Anonymization and Consent Management at the source Data to ensure that any personal information is treated based on the user consent. All data in platform is tagged to ensure multi\-level access for consumers based on the data provider consent.

**Company Website:** http://www.cerebrumx.ai

Pay: Up to ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Gurugram, Haryana

title: Infra Tech Support Practitioner
description:
**Project Role :** Infra Tech Support Practitioner  

**Project Role Description :** Provide L1–L2 technical support for infrastructure, systems, and applications in production and development environments, both remotely and onsite, following defined operating models and processes. Act as the primary interface with users/clients to accurately diagnose issues and deliver effective resolutions across infrastructure, operating systems, networks, and application platforms, ensuring service stability and quality support.
  

**Must have skills :** Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure DevOps  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As an Infra Tech Support Practitioner, a typical day involves delivering first and second level technical assistance for infrastructure, systems, and applications across both production and development settings. This role requires working closely with users and clients to identify and resolve issues efficiently, ensuring smooth operation and stability of services. The position includes providing support through remote and onsite engagements, adhering to established procedures and operational frameworks to maintain high\-quality service delivery and minimize downtime.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* AKS Cluster Provisioning and Configuration: Deploy and set up AKS clusters with appropriate configurations using Terraform and Azure DevOps.

  

Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve issues related to Kubernetes, AKS clusters and related components like Istio, GitOps, Autoscaling, Helm, Kustomize etc. Need to troubleshoot issues related to Terraform during AKS Cluster deployment.
  

  

Upgrades and Patches: Plan and perform AKS upgrades and apply security patches to keep the clusters up\-to\-date and secure.
  

  

ITSM: Need to work on incidents, Change Requests, RCAs, CMDB etc.
  

  

Documentation: Need to create documentation related to AKS.
  

  

Shifts and On\-call: Need to work on night shifts and on\-calls on a rotational basis, as and when required by the team.
  

  

Meetings and Calls: Need to participate in various calls and discussions with different teams as AKS SME and to share required inputs as Kubernetes / AKS SME.  

  

  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure DevOps.


Kubernetes : In\-depth knowledge of Kubernetes concepts, architecture, and administration.
  

  

Should have in\-depth knowledge on core Kubernetes concepts like Pods, Deployments, Services, Namespaces, PVs, PVCs, Storage Classes, Role Assignments, Kubernetes Networking, PDBs, HPA etc. Need to have proficiency on working with kubectl tool. Need to have good knowledge and understanding on YAML files related to Kubernetes.
  

  

AKS : Should have in\-depth knowledge on AKS concepts like Node Pools, AKS RBAC, AKS upgradation, Node OS upgradation, AKS Monitoring, AKS Logging, Workload Identity etc.
  

  

Azure DevOps: Working knowledge of Azure DevOps , which includes Azure Repo, branching strategy, pull requests, and git commands. Must know how to use Azure DevOps through IDE tool like VS Code.
  

  

Azure : Proficiency in using Azure services, especially Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  

  

Should have good knowledge on Azure Services like VNet, Subnet, UDR, NSG, Private Endpoint, Private DNS, Managed Identity, Role Assignment, Key Vault, Storage Account , Load Balancer etc.
  

  

Terraform: Should have experience in using terraform to deploy Azure Services and AKS Cluster.
  

  

AKS Cluster Provisioning and Configuration: Deploy and set up AKS clusters with appropriate configurations using Terraform.
  

  

Monitoring and Logging: Should have good knowledge on monitoring and logging solutions to gain insights into cluster performance, application behavior, and resource usage.
  

  

Security: Should have good knowledge on security best practices for AKS, including RBAC (Role\-Based Access Control), network policies, and secure container images.
  

  

Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve issues related to AKS clusters, Kubernetes, Terraform, and infrastructure components.
  

  

Upgrades and Patches: Plan and perform AKS upgrades and apply security patches to keep the clusters up\-to\-date and secure, using in\-line or blue\-green upgradation approach.
  

  

GitOps : Working knowledge of any of the GitOps tool (Flux / ArgoCD) is preferred.
  

  

Service Mesh : Knowledge of a Service Mesh product (ex: Istio) is preferred.
  

  

Troubleshooting Skills: Ability to diagnose and resolve issues related to Kubernetes and containerized applications.
  

  

Cloud Native Ecosystem: Awareness of other cloud\-native tools and technologies such as Istio, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
  

  

Communication and Teamwork: Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
  

  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Kubernetes.
* This position is based at our Gurugram office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education

title: IT Support Associate II
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. OTS IT provides nonstop global IT support to Amazon Operations as a vital piece to the puzzle. We take ownership for what we do — whether supporting IT infrastructure, developing new technology in\-house, launching a new Amazon Operations facility, or delighting our customers by delivering packages directly to them.OTS IT provides global IT support to Amazon Operations, including Fulfillment, Sortation, Logistics, and Last Mile...  

  

About The Role  

Ops Tech IT Support Engineers will be responsible for utilizing their skills to provide assistance to the operations team in resolving technical problems within these sites that cover a multitude of technical disciplines. The IT Support Engineers position is the first level of support for the operations of the Amazon Sites and becomes the voice and face of the IT department to our customers.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

Maintenance of IT equipment throughout the Fullfillment sites.  

Troubleshooting of all IT related equipment such as PCs, wireless handheld devices, thin clients, printers and other end user devices.  

Manage RMA and repair process for all devices under warranty.  

Support the Senior Engineers in daily projects and activities as directed.  

We have a 5\-day work week but given the 7 days a week operation, the 2 scheduled days off will vary based on shift patterns and business needs.  

The position will require supporting of multiple buildings around the area and flexible to travel to sites with in the state /region.  

Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to while performing work


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1\+ years of corporate setting Windows, Mac or Linux Operating systems support experience
* Experience troubleshooting integrated and interdependent computer systems
* Experience maintaining zebra thermal printers, troubleshooting thin clients, PCs, scanners, and portable handheld terminals

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* CompTIA A\+, CompTIA Network\+, Cisco/CCNA, Linux (Redhat), Microsoft hardware (installation), AWS, or other industry relevant certifications
* Experience in a dynamic environment with a high degree of customer service

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information.
